items.prompt: For singleton families from input ["ba","ac"], which output follows the family tie rule?

options.why: That orders by sorted-letter keys ab then ac, not by first original member.
These tickers have different letter multisets and cannot form one family.
The original ticker ba must not be replaced by its canonical key ab.
Equal-size families are ordered by their first sorted original ticker: ac before ba.

items.explanation: Equal-size families are ordered by their first sorted original ticker: ac before ba.
